newsitem.title: DUBAI: Sept Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr nine pct.
newsitem.headline: Sept Dubai air cargo volumes up yr/yr nine pct.

text.p: Dubai airport cargo volumes rose nine percent in September to 29,805 tonnes from 27,262 tonnes in the same month last year, Dubai Cargo Village figures show.

Uplifted cargo -- or exports -- rose a year-on-year six percent in September to 14,016 tonnes, and discharged cargo -- or imports -- moved up 12 percent to 15,788 tonnes. The figures include transit goods but do not include courier and mail items.
Trans-shipments in the month totalled 5,360 tonnes, an 18 percent increase on September 1995's figure.
Sea-air freight volumes fell a year-on-year 19 percent in September to nearly 4,709 tonnes.
This is the sixth consecutive fall so far in 1996. It follows year-on-year drops of 34.7 percent in April, 17.7 percent in May, 3.3 percent in June, 8.6 percent in July and 16.4 percent in August.
Dubai is the second largest emirate and commercial centre of the seven members of the United Arab Emirates. -- Dubai newsroom +9714 - 626990
